title: Validation, Error Handling and API Testing
description: Bean Validation on requests, global error handling and standard ProblemDetail error responses (the S9 required lab and the FT5 project brief), then API testing with @MockitoBean and MockMvc and debugging a failing request.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Standard S1-S13 and Fast FT1-FT8. This module covers Standard S9-S10.

S9 carries calendar requiredLab true: the module coding lab (Standard lab overlay) is required there and spans two days: Tasks 1, 2, 3 and 6 in the S9 guided-lab block, and Tasks 4, 5, 7 and 8 (the S10 testing objectives) in the S10 Concept day's "Faded, then fresh problem" coding-lab block (40 minutes) after its three pages; S10 has no lab overlay of its own. Pacing decision recorded 2026-11-17 by the coverage-gap lab stream.

FT5 (calendar Lab, requiredLab true) is presented on the Fast track as Project implementation: its four rows map 'shared' to their canonical topics and to the project brief error-handling-project (row 3, logging, lives in integration-and-observability).
Fast mapping: FT4 row 4 (MockMvc), FT5 rows 0-2 and FT6 rows 5-6 map here.

Module coding lab authored at coding-lab/ (Standard lab overlay): mvn -q -o test, offline after one setup, no container engine; Fast skips coding labs. The calendar marks this module's lab day requiredLab true, so the lab is Standard's required practice.

Lab coverage gap (recorded 2026-11-18): the module coding lab does not claim standard-error-responses-with-problemdetail#o2. Its executable checks cover only the enablement half (built-in problem details for a framework exception: a 400 problem+json body for GET /bookings/0); predicting the validation-failure body stays a README-guided formative self-check with no independent shipped oracle, so claiming the combined objective would overstate executable coverage. Open for later resolution.
